title: Freeze-readiness evidence for the shared-kernel catalog

role_assignments._run_id_disambiguation: /claude/r0_steward (Anthropic) is THIS package's Integration Owner and must record its own capability declaration before this package leaves backlog. /root/r0_steward (OpenAI Codex) is a DIFFERENT run: it is the Integration Owner of WP-0A-A0-001 and WP-0A-CON-001 and is named in open_blockers solely because it must countersign the amendments made to those two packages and record the WP-0A-CON-001 npm run check addendum. Neither run substitutes for the other. Independent testing flagged the near-identical names as ambiguous; both are intended.

independence.cross_vendor_exception: prefer_cross_vendor_review is NOT satisfied: every assigned run is Anthropic claude-opus-5. The Decision Register (§ cross-vendor review) permits this only as an explicit exception - 'if there is no cross-vendor capacity, use an independent agent per run and record the exception'. Each of the five roles is a separate agent run with its own capability declaration and no run reviewed, tested, or integrated its own work. The Integration Owner must carry this exception forward; it is not waived and it is not equivalent to cross-vendor review.

required_human_authorities: A6 sign-off for CTR-AUD-001, CTR-OBS-001 and CTR-USG-001
purpose: Ten shared-kernel contracts are still Draft, and the Decision Register permits only exploratory spikes against a Draft contract. Every consumer package waiting to build a fake or a consumer test is blocked on that, while nine of the ten already carry the schema and fixtures Candidate v1 asks for. This package gathers the evidence for each contract against its OWN required_before_freeze list and puts it in front of the owners. It changes no status: promotion is a decision its owner and the Product Owner make.

include: RFC-2026-010 recording, per contract, which required_before_freeze items are present and by what artifact
An explicit statement of what the check does NOT establish, item by item
Routing of the four co-owned contracts to A1 and A6 rather than promoting them
A machine-written verification record, and the runner-side check that a stale record fails the build
A branch-scope guard: what a branch CHANGED, checked against what its package declares
A pinned catalog registry: every contract's freeze level, owner and freeze requirements, and the index that must agree with them
Conformance and truthfulness checks over every author handoff
A command that rebuilds the integrity manifest, which four documents already told someone to do without one existing
exclude: Any change to a contract status, in a manifest, in the catalog index or in the Decision Register
CTR-NTF-001, which A5 owns and which this package does not assess
Mutation coverage as a promotion criterion; it is quoted as context and is not a bar
Production schema, migrations, provider calls and every other Gate G0 restriction

amends_without_owning.rationale: Recorded after scripts/verify-branch-scope.mjs reported 26 undeclared paths on this branch. Every one is real work done here and none of it was declared, which is the drift the new guard exists to stop. Grouped by why: (a) the runner, package.json and the integrity manifest carry the verification-record control and belong to WP-0A-A0-002 and WP-0A-A0-001; (b) schema-mutation-coverage.test.mjs and the ctr-api-001, ctr-idm-001 and ctr-pag-001 fixtures are corrections made on this branch in response to independent review findings six through nine, and belong to WP-0A-CON-003 and WP-0A-CON-007 -- they were made here because the findings arrived against this head and moving them down the stack risked the fixture loss a bulk rebase resolution has already caused once; (c) the ten author handoffs are each their own package's deliverable, placed here for the reason recorded in evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/handoffs.md; (d) three work-package manifests carry amendment records pointing back at this package; (e) OVERNIGHT-SUMMARY.md is the Product Owner briefing and belongs to no package. The workflow and the manifests below were carried up the stack so every downstream pull request runs the same branch-scope step; .github/workflows/ci.yml belongs to WP-0A-A0-004 and each manifest to its own package. The branch-scope guard and its test were authored here and MOVED to WP-0A-A0-004, because only the workflow that package owns can supply a pull request base ref. This package amends them and claims neither. Independent review eleven added three more amendments to this list. The coverage floor, its contract and its test belong to WP-0A-A0-002; this package adds PROTECTED_KEYS to them because the review deleted seven manifest entries -- the branch-scope guard, all four protocol schemas, the catalog index and the secret scanner -- and the check still exited 0. A floor stated as a length is satisfied by whatever remains, so the files whose ABSENCE is itself the defect are now named. The named set found a real gap immediately: scripts/regenerate-integrity-manifest.mjs, the tool that rewrites the manifest, was not in the manifest. Review eleven's finding seven required one more sweep: every work-package manifest now declares ownership.branch, because the CI scope step derived its package from the branch NAME -- an unparseable name skipped the guard at exit 0, and a parseable one selected which manifest the branch was judged against. The declaration has to live in each package's own manifest, so this package amends all of them for that single field and claims none. CTR-USG-001's schema is amended to delete a shipped `allOf: []`, found by review eleven's finding eight: it accepts every document and the mutation walk cannot see it, because there is nothing inside to delete. It was left behind when a vacuous rule was removed in b00c6b3. The contract belongs to WP-0A-CON-006; the deletion is a removal of a no-op, not a change to any rule. package.json gains refresh:handoff and check:handoff for the same reason it gained record:verification: a handoff can cite a range that is entirely true and still describe none of the branch -- this one cited 653f699..ae5864d, accurate and blind to every guard added after it, including the two revision checks that were supposed to keep handoffs honest. The range is regenerated from history rather than typed. scripts/scan-repository-secrets.mjs belongs to WP-0A-A0-003 and is amended here to delete an unreachable `return false;` after a return -- review eleven's finding nine. CI caught this as undeclared while the local run did not, because the local invocation used the merge-base with CON-007 and the pull request is based on 653f699. Run the guard with the PR's own base sha, not a convenient one. catalog-reference-integrity.test.mjs belongs to WP-0A-CON-007 and is amended here to require a $ref to target a top-level contract directory of a governed group -- review twelve's HIGH 2, a permanent rule channel outside every ratchet. CI reported it undeclared while the local run said all 74 paths were declared, because I ran the guard BEFORE committing and it diffs base..HEAD: an uncommitted change is invisible to it. Run the scope guard after the commit, with the pull request's own base sha. Review thirteen required amendments in two more packages. json-schema-subset.mjs belongs to WP-0A-A0-002 and is corrected here because a BOOLEAN subschema -- `items: false`, `allOf: [false]` -- is a real rule that its truthiness tests read as no rule at all, which is the exact invariant its own header states. validate-work-package-ownership.mjs and branch-scope.test.mjs belong to WP-0A-A0-001 and WP-0A-A0-004 and are amended because amends_without_owning.paths -- this very field -- was validated by nothing, and `["**"]` silenced the branch-scope guard entirely. The entry .agents/** is replaced by the protocol schemas this package actually changed. A glob covering four protected files is a permission over the schemas that decide what any package may claim; it is named or it is not amended. Five declarations are removed because deadAmendments showed they explain nothing this branch changed: ctr-sec-001, ctr-ten-001, the catalog index, WP-0A-CON-007's evidence and WP-0A-A6-001's manifest are all untouched in 653f699..HEAD, confirmed by git diff per path. They were carried forward from earlier rounds whose work was rebuilt away, and each one was a standing permission over another package's files granted for work that never happened. .agents/work-package.schema.json is amended here because review fifteen showed it was digested, protected and read by no validator at all: additionalProperties was true, security_privacy was a bare object, and twelve keys every manifest uses were undeclared. The Decision Register and CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md are now digested in the integrity manifest -- the two documents every catalog ratchet cites, protected by nothing until review fifteen -- but neither file is edited here, so neither is amended. repository-json.test.mjs belongs to WP-0A-A0-001 and is amended here because review sixteen replaced .github/workflows/ci.yml with a workflow_dispatch stub -- deleting the independent guard step, branch-identity and branch-scope -- while the three regexes that file asserts all still matched, at exit 0. The workflow is the outside anchor the integrity manifest's own note names for a tripwire with no self-anchor, so what CI RUNS is now asserted there. Two more protocol validators are amended here, both owned by WP-0A-A0-001: their entry-point checks compared resolve(process.argv[1]) with fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), and review eighteen showed that a symlinked parent directory makes those never match, so main() never runs and the guard exits 0 having done nothing. Every script in the repository got the same one-line correction in this commit; leaving two of them behind would have left the hole open through whichever one a caller reached first.

acceptance_criteria: Every required_before_freeze item is assessed against the shipped schema and fixture list, not against a fixture count.
The assessment states plainly that it establishes PRESENCE of an artifact and not that the artifact satisfies the intent behind the phrase, with the specific items where that gap is widest named.
No contract status changes anywhere in the repository.
Contracts with a co-owner are routed to that co-owner rather than proposed for promotion by A0 alone.
npm run check stays green with no test skipped.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. One decision record and one manifest; no code, no contract, no schema and no status changed.
open_blockers: RFC-2026-010 is Proposed. Until the Product Owner disposes of it, every contract stays Draft and consumers stay limited to exploratory spikes.
A1 and A6 sign-off is outstanding for four contracts and cannot be represented by an agent.

The freeze check establishes presence, not sufficiency. Four items are named in the RFC where a script cannot see what the phrase meant: stable ordering, auth rules, decimal money and bounded cardinality.
CTR-NTF-001 remains unassessed; A5 owns it.
